payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-09-25 (PR #3019): the sign-off tool now exists — npm run clinical:review -- --write --walk --kind form, guide docs/clinical-sign-off-how-to.md (sign on a dated clinical-signoff-<date> branch cut from main). Recommended order 3C, 10B, 10E, 11B, 11E, 6C, then the rest. If the owner already pushed sign-offs to the frozen claude/sweet-carson-e7ur0s-wa-signoff branch, merge data/forms-content-review.json from it into main first (form pins carry over unchanged). Only the owner may sign.
